property_summary: After a fallback call with 10 ether when block.number is not a multiple of 15, the reference contract does not transfer the balance (because block.number % 15 == 0 is false), while the buggy contract does transfer (because block.number % 15 != 0 is true).
change_summary: Change the condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0
